vouchers_import.error.server: Something went wrong importing this file. Nothing was saved.
vouchers_import.help: Bring in the outstanding balances on physical voucher cards your customers already hold from another system, as an opening balance — not a new sale. Upload a CSV with a code column (the code printed on each card), a balance column, and an optional label naming the holder. Preview first — nothing is saved until you press Confirm import. A code that already exists on this till is skipped, never overwritten, so importing the same file twice is safe.
vouchers_import.status.bad_balance: balance could not be read as an amount
vouchers_import.status.check_failed: could not be verified — try again
vouchers_import.status.code_exists: a voucher with this code already exists — not overwritten
vouchers_import.status.duplicate_code_in: this code appears more than once in the file — neither row was imported
vouchers_import.status.non_positive_bala: balance must be greater than zero
vouchers_import.status.not_active: already used up or void — nothing left to import
vouchers_import.status.single_purpose: a voucher for a specific item (already taxed when sold) — it can't be imported as a balance
vouchers_import.title: Import voucher balances
